{
  "conventions": [
    "TypeScript 5.9 strict mode with ESNext modules; cross-package imports use @excalidraw/<pkg> aliases and intra-package imports use relative paths.",
    "Maintain ESLint import/order blank-line-separated groups: external packages, @excalidraw/* runtime imports, @excalidraw/* and relative import type declarations, relative runtime imports, and .scss stylesheet imports last.",
    "React components use named export const arrow functions with a local type Props = {...} and a sibling PascalCase.scss stylesheet; never use default exports for new components.",
    "Use app.ownerDocument and app.ownerWindow instead of global document or window for new DOM API usage inside editor components and actions; prefer Merge<Base, Overrides> from @excalidraw/common/utility-types.",
    "Never draw from randomId(), randomInteger(), or Math.random() on editor mount, restore, legacy file load, or element creation; the default page always uses the fixed constant DEFAULT_PAGE_ID ('page-default') and DEFAULT_PAGE_NAME ('Page 1').",
